embeds.title: 🟡 Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability CVE-2026-9082 Added to CISA KEV Catalog
embeds.description:
CISA added CVE-2026-9082, a critical SQL injection vulnerability in Drupal Core affecting all supported versions, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog based on evidence of active exploitation. Drupal released patches on May 22, 2026, and Imperva reports observing over 15,000 attack attempts targeting almost 6,000 sites across 65 countries, with attacks primarily targeting gaming and financial services sectors. The vulnerability could allow privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests to the database abstraction API.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-9082 • **Access:** specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API
**Incident date:** 2026-05-22 • **Confidence:** reported

embeds.description:
A maximum-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-48172, CVSS 10.0) in LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Plugin versions 2.3 to 2.4.4 is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows any cPanel user to execute arbitrary scripts as root via the lsws.redisAble function due to incorrect privilege assignment. LiteSpeed has released patched versions 2.4.7 (cPanel plugin) and 5.3.1.0 (WHM plugin) to address the vulnerability.
